analysis_domains.likert_480: F4/F6 domain; 480 rows / 3360 dimension records coverage table; per-dimension valid n and NE/NA/failed reported; not part of F1

program_A_native.glm_low_reference: A_GLM_LOW_REFERENCE_AXES_121.tsv, REFERENCE_ONLY_NOT_ONE_OF_MAIN_4, never ranked with the main four
program_A_native.rule: old-gold historical values and new-gold derived sensitivity stay in separate columns; the two gold versions must never be mixed into one ranking

program_B_primary.denominator: fixed common 120 cases per model (480 slots)
program_B_primary.unit_of_inference: case (paired/clustered); the four answers of one case and multiple layers are NOT independent samples

bootstrap_spec.record: number of undefined replicates (e.g., zero-variance kappa) recorded, not silently dropped
bootstrap_spec.resample: case_ids with replacement within the analysis domain; statistic = mean paired difference; CI = percentile 2.5/97.5

clustering_and_missing_data.missing: numeric missingness compared only on the actual paired set; sample selection and coverage differences reported
clustering_and_missing_data.rule: four answers of the same case and seven Likert dimensions of one answer are never treated as independent samples

dependency_gap.impact_on_F1_deliverables: none: F1 delivers descriptives only; p-values are computed at F6
dependency_gap.install_plan_pending_user_authorization: python3 -m pip install 'scipy>=1.11' (NETWORK=0 during F1; installation is a user-authorized step, not performed offline)

A_batch_program.family: 6 pairwise on old-gold historical weighted_total (primary), Holm
A_batch_program.mechanics: same as M family with equivalence threshold 100/121 = 0.8264
A_batch_program.new_gold_view: descriptive sensitivity only; separate columns; no mixed-gold ranking
A_batch_program.when: only if ranking/significance claims are made on batch A

H_human_anchor_external_validity.ci: case-level bootstrap B=2000 seed=20261029, resampling within the original sampling strata; undefined replicate count recorded
H_human_anchor_external_validity.kappa: linear weighted Cohen's kappa, weights 1-|i-j|/9, fixed integer categories 1..10
H_human_anchor_external_validity.missing: excluded per pairwise-complete with n reported per dimension; zero-variance kappa = UNDEFINED (never 0)
H_human_anchor_external_validity.primary_values: original independent human scores first; third-person adjudicated values only as subsequent reference
H_human_anchor_external_validity.threshold_rule: no kappa pass threshold is invented; teacher has not set one
H_human_anchor_external_validity.weighting: in-sample descriptives AND sampling-probability-weighted whole-frame estimates reported separately if extrapolation is attempted; the stratified 72-answer mean is not passed off as the 480 population accuracy
H_human_anchor_external_validity.when: F5/F6 after real human scores return; frozen now

L_layer_pairwise_B_secondary.ci: same bootstrap spec as M family
L_layer_pairwise_B_secondary.comparisons: 6 pairs x 5 layers = 30 tests, own Holm family, labelled SECONDARY

M_model_pairwise_B_primary.ci: case-level bootstrap, B=2000, seed=20261029, resample cases with replacement, percentile 2.5/97.5
M_model_pairwise_B_primary.comparisons: 6 pairwise model comparisons, case-level paired differences
M_model_pairwise_B_primary.equivalence_wording_rule: |delta mean| < 100/N (N=120 -> 0.8333) is less than one full-mark question equivalent; report as INDISTINGUISHABLE, not as equality
M_model_pairwise_B_primary.multiplicity: Holm over the 6 tests if significance is claimed, alpha=0.05

R_recovery_sensitivity.causality_rule: recovery was selective, not randomized; no causal claim that recovery raised scores
R_recovery_sensitivity.data: B480 new-gold program scores split by recovered flag (20 recovered vs 460 non-recovered)
R_recovery_sensitivity.dual_view_rule: both the recovery-inclusive 120-case view and the common all-four-native 100-case subset view are delivered whether or not tests are significant; if a signal exists the main conclusion highlights the common non-recovered subset per teacher 2026-10-15
R_recovery_sensitivity.eligibility: run only when both group n >= 2; otherwise NOT_ESTIMABLE (never reported as 'no difference')
R_recovery_sensitivity.mandatory_descriptives: n, mean, median, min, q1, q3, max per group per model regardless of test eligibility (delivered in RECOVERY_SENSITIVITY.tsv)
R_recovery_sensitivity.multiplicity: Holm step-down over the estimable tests of this family, alpha=0.05
R_recovery_sensitivity.planned_tests: 4 models x 6 endpoints (5 science layers + science_weighted_total_100) = 24 planned tests, one family

principle: Methods are pre-registered here before any Likert or human-anchor result exists; F6 must not select tests, families or endpoints after seeing results; unplanned comparisons must be flagged EXPLORATORY.

test_library_requirements.mannwhitneyu: scipy.stats.mannwhitneyu (two-sided, exact or asymptotic per scipy default with ties handling documented at F6)
test_library_requirements.policy: use existing mature libraries; if a dependency is still missing at F6, report the version and installation plan and wait for user-authorized network; do NOT hand-roll unverified test implementations (contract 11.1)
